title: Events and Messaging
readerIntent: Understand how Nodics decouples module reactions while preserving delivery meaning and ownership.
owner: Framework events, broker messaging, and persisted NEMS distribution capabilities
summary: Local listeners, broker transport, and persisted distribution are separate contracts; a publisher declares a business fact without hardcoding every consumer.

sections.heading: Business outcomes
items: Add or replace reactions without editing the publishing capability.
Support consolidated and distributed module topology.
Use persisted distribution, retry, and event logs when delivery requires them.
Integrate a broker through an adapter instead of embedding client logic in listeners.

sections.heading: Three responsibilities
items: Framework events register and execute in-platform listeners.
Messaging adapters transport events across processes or infrastructure.
NEMS owns persisted definitions, distribution state, event logs, retry, and manual recovery.
